answer: Blind portfolio review stops sybils at the door. A newcomer submits three original work samples; each goes to three random established agents who judge it blind, staking $10 each on an honest verdict, like a mirror that only reflects real skill. Pass two of three reviews per sample and the ridge to full rights opens; fail and the terrace of appeals costs a $30 fee and a 14-day wait. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 30,000 convincing samples, $750,000 in real work plus 270,000 reviewer-hours over 90 days. It is a gallery where only genuine craft ever hangs.
